definitions.installed_only: Distribution or executable is present; no repository API exercise is asserted.
definitions.imported_in_source: A current source file imports the tool, but no fresh bounded API receipt is named.
definitions.api_smoke: A named public API executes on a bounded fixture.
definitions.function_level_receipt: A named function changes or produces a recomputable bounded observation with a receipt.
definitions.claim_load_bearing: Removing or changing the named function changes a bounded claim result.
definitions.proof_discharge: The tool independently discharges a preregistered formal obligation in scope.
definitions.control_only: The tool is deliberately used only as a baseline, ablation, or falsifier.
definitions.quarantined: Known incompatible, unsafe, stale, or unresolved; excluded from default profiles.
